verdict.rationale: Honeycomb offers an official MCP server and 'agent-skills' plugin that let an AI agent query live telemetry to 'investigate and diagnose latency or error spikes' and 'suggest optimization opportunities' (honeycomb-docs-9, -10, -20, -26, -34, -35), which covers root-cause style investigation. However this capability is delivered by connecting an external AI agent to Honeycomb data rather than a fully native, always-on 'platform AI' that proactively investigates alerts and auto-generates root-cause reports, and there's no independent hands-on evidence of investigation quality. Missing for 10: native (non-MCP) automated root-cause reporting tied directly to trigger/SLO alerts, and independent verification of investigation accuracy.
